description:
Cut your team's email management time in half & get started on the road to a cleaner inbox and more productive day with SaneBox. Start your free trial now!

Email Filtering: Automatically sorts unimportant emails into folders like SaneLater for better organization. SaneBlackHole: Allows users to unsubscribe from unwanted emails effortlessly. SaneReminders: Sets reminders to follow up on emails or send them at a later time. Attachment Management: Easily saves email attachments to linked cloud storage services.
